Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"): r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 2: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C2"): r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 3: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"), xlRows: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 4: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:B3"): r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 5: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"), xlColumns: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 6: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"), xlColumns: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"), xlRows: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 7: c.PlotBy = xlColumns: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 8: c.SeriesCollection(1).Values = "=One!$B$2:$C$2": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 9: c.SeriesCollection(1).Values = "=One!$B$3:$C$3": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 10: c.SeriesCollection(2).Values = "=One!$B$2:$C$2": r = c.SeriesCollection(2).Formula
    Case 11: c.SeriesCollection(1).Values = Array(1, 2): r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 12: c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 13: c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula = "=SERIES(""N"",One!$B$1:$C$1,One!$B$2:$C$2,1)": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 14: c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula = "=SERIES(One!$A$2,One!$B$1:$C$1,One!$B$3:$C$3,1)": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Act(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long, ByVal first As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, c As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set c = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
    If first <> "" Then Labelled c
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function

Public Sub Labelled(c As Object)
    c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowCategoryName = True: c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True
End Sub
